Home.description: Full-stack and data engineering projects, case studies and learning experiences by Kuan-Yu Hsien.

why.title: Why before How
why.body: Intent matters most. I need to understand the fundamental reason behind a problem before jumping into execution.

candid.title: Radically Candid
candid.body: Honest feedback over polite silence. I value direct communication that helps everyone grow and keeps things moving.

iteration.body: Nothing is perfect on the first try. I prefer acting fast, gathering feedback, and constantly refining the approach.
